claim_recovery_table.claim: Cloud-seeding activity is spatially concentrated in a small number of western U.S. states
claim_recovery_table.evidence: Top 3 states (CA, CO, UT) = 58.5% of projects; HHI = 0.155; only 13 states active

claim_recovery_table.claim: Annual activity peaked in early-to-mid 2000s and declined through 2010s with COVID minimum
claim_recovery_table.evidence: Peak 2003 (49 projects), minimum 2020 (12 projects), mean 32.0/year, recovery to 28-34 in 2022-2025

claim_recovery_table.claim: Snowpack augmentation and precipitation enhancement dominate stated purposes
claim_recovery_table.evidence: Snowpack 47.0% + precipitation 38.8% = 85.8% of purpose mentions; water-supply total 90.7%

claim_recovery_table.claim: Silver iodide is the overwhelmingly dominant seeding agent
claim_recovery_table.evidence: Silver iodide (+ variants) = 95.6% of all projects (795/832)

claim_recovery_table.claim: Ground-based delivery is the most common apparatus type
Agent-apparatus deployment shows silver iodide used across all delivery methods
claim_recovery_table.evidence: Cross-tabulation shows AgI in ground (446), airborne (218), combined (131); only agent in all 3
